title: Research: audit already removed QQ16 centres and actual outer consumer boundaries
body:
The proposed centre-retirement task has a changed source premise: **all eight selected H8 centre children are already absent from the actual QQ16 core**. `joint-query/source_data.py` removes their phase and inserts a paid dirty-state correction. This audit independently traces their original lifetimes, regenerates both corrected words byte-for-byte and pins two real outer consumers of PR3952's reduced F17 interface. It establishes precise obstructions, no new supplier or kappa.

The inherited correction contains 580 ADDs and 16 CLEARs. After subtracting the removed scalar phase, net scalar increases are 3,372 forward / 3,324 backward; each corrected core has scalar allowance 202,138 and native rank mass 5,522. Actual F0 and B1_2 have no H8 and add respectively eight and 24 H1 lines. Original C buffers clear by event12758 before call exit; their effects have been applied to L. Existing removal credit belongs to the QQ16/source lineage, not this audit.

Two pinned boundaries explain why the 96 earlier `y1_U` outputs do not close the caller:

- **Actual ordinary bridge before F2:** the hosted physical prefix includes a pair1 idle sweep between B1 and the bridge. Eight independent, reachable integer inputs, constant in both owner and payload, give the same 96 projected zeros but different bridge outputs. The bridge therefore cannot factor through that projection alone. The template still names its original gauge44 provider; this audits the real continuation proposed for a QQ16 substitution, not an admitted complete substitution.
- **PR2707 full F0-inverse suffix:** checkpoint2740 requires all224 F17 x1/y1 values. The projection lacks112 x1 and16 selected y1 fields; event2741 already requires absent Z0. Exact readsets, reachable collisions and all128 missing boundary directions are checked. Missing fields are not a lower bound of128 new families: current borrowed X/Y remain available to a redesigned paid consumer.

The retained complete recovery fallback is fully priced: **336 H1,672 wrappers,464 maps,1,808 unit ADDs,896 quarter ADDs,312 CLEARs; scalar allowance25,840; private16**. With H8 absent it still fails the unchanged conditional pair screen: **[1.000097677880011248,1.000097677880011249] >1**. This prices an existing feasible fallback, not an optimality theorem. The reduced112-H1 endpoint passes that relaxation, so the obstruction is composition and access, not its local algebra.

Independent rational arithmetic reproduces the old fixed-total two/three-H8 threshold, while distinguishing reallocation into ideal idle work from literal deletion that changes total mass/centre. Neither grants another retirement credit. Family stock, invocation counts and coverage must be proved for a changed consumer before transporting the screen. Physical movement/placement, cleanup and return, precision/dirty-helper ranges and both all-depth supplier caps remain open.

Only `research/qq16-centre-lifetime-boundary-audit/` is added. `PROOF.md` contains the argument and limits; RESULT.json retains the full checked receipt. SOURCES.json pins twelve canonical inputs. PR3952's WORD is retained as authenticated data, not an executable dependency; replay imports no predecessor executable. PREDECESSORS.json records exact heads, blobs and reuse. Frozen science and selected frontier are unchanged.

Validation on Linux CPython3.12.3, standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -Werror -B research/qq16-centre-lifetime-boundary-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -O -Werror -B research/qq16-centre-lifetime-boundary-audit/test_verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-centre-lifetime-boundary-audit
```

Normal/optimized receipts are byte-identical. Registered replay passes; seven integrity/export groups pass, including read-only Git-free replay, pre-execution source authentication, retained-word corruption and typed whole-receipt rejection. Exact evidence covers all eight C lifetimes/frames, corrected-word equality,712 scalar columns, helper/private cleanup, actual bridge collisions, full recovery input census/invoice and outward rational intervals. Published-byte/source-history preflight passes for **28 package/input files at head82c812c45fbc2bc2751e5a0d02a3631af25c3cba**; whitespace check passes. VERIFICATION.json lists unrun selected cold replay, huge native kernels, physical tape execution, all-depth supplier proofs and human/formal review. Hosted CI pending.

Explicit assigned continuation of #3952 head996ff698d3efd0bdce606e240f3b00e6ab91e7fc, following #3946/#3908. Canonical main20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90 and priority revision6 were refreshed at start, source-impact checkpoint and publication, unchanged. Scope refined when exact sources showed no surviving centre target. Three user-requested agents independently audited provenance, recovery boundary and budget, then cross-reviewed one another; a separate agent also reviewed the root bridge witnesses and integrated scope. REVIEWS.json records limits; no independent human review. Targeted live PR search plus the repository helper covered adjacent work partially: no gh/complete remote snapshots, hence no novelty guarantee. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3952#issuecomment-6261523096).

**Next bounded step:** choose one exact paid composition boundary. Either reconstruct/encode the128 missing full-recovery checkpoint values from current X/Y more cheaply than the336-H1 fallback, or let the real bridge consume a changed encoding while identifying source reads/operations that genuinely disappear. Derive arbitrary-array equations, frames, lifetime/return and a full bill; establish integer invocation/family coverage before using the budget. Stop on a missing access/cleanup contract or a failing complete invoice. Further centre deletion or isolated precision work is not justified by this result. TASK.json retains original card, checkpoints, first steps and blockers.
